service.description: Records a grant (PconGranted) or withdrawal (PconWithdrawn) of consent for a purpose: for an address (contactMechId, one of the party's), for the party (none), or as a list subscription change (contactListId). Each call is a new PartyConsent row. For a marketing purpose of an address (PcpMarketingEmail for an email address; PcpSms or PcpPhone for a phone number) without a list, the address's allowSolicitation is set to match: Y while any of those purposes is granted on it, else N, on each of its current PartyContactMech rows through ContactServices.store#PartyContactMech. The source defaults to PcsStaff for a signed-in user, else PcsApi. A signed-in user does not record consent for another user's personal contact.

parameter.name: consentDate
parameter.description: Defaults to now; an import may give the original date

parameter.name: allowSolicitation
parameter.description: The address's new allowSolicitation, when it follows this change

service.description: A party's consent state, for the Consent edit dialog, a Customer 360 box and the unsubscribe page: consentList, the current state of each purpose per address and for the party (the latest row without a list); addressList, the party's current email addresses and phone numbers (and earlier ones that have consent rows) with their allowSolicitation and consentList; listList, the consent lists the party has a row on (not mailboxes unless they have members by email) with the party's status (its latest current row, else its latest row), subscribed, and the list's last consent change; grantedPurposeEnumIds. sameOwnerAsListId limits the lists to those of that list's organization (ownerPartyId, an empty one matching only empty ones).

The consent audit of a party, newest first: when, purpose, granted or withdrawn, source, evidence, the address and list, and who recorded it, with the descriptions; by address, purpose and list, a page at a time.

The Consent list: one row per party with consent data (a PartyConsent row, a row on a consent list, or a current email address or phone number with allowSolicitation set), those the user may see (not another user's personal contacts, not merged parties): its name, primary email (EmailPrimary first) and phone (PhonePrimary, then PhoneMobile, first) with their allowSolicitation, its consent lists with its status on each, the purposes granted and withdrawn (current states), and the last change with its source. Filters: text (part of the name, an email, a phone number or the party id); contactListId (on that list); statusId, a ContactListParty status (CLPT_*: on contactListId, or on any consent list) or a consent status (PconGranted, PconWithdrawn: of purposeEnumId, or of any purpose); purposeEnumId (granted, unless statusId says withdrawn); changedFromDate and changedThruDate (a consent change in the period); allowSolicitation (Y or N on any current address). A page at a time, or with exportCsv every match as CSV text (csvText).

parameter.name: orderByField
parameter.description: partyName, lastChangeDate, emailAddress or partyId, with - for descending

service.description: Internal: subscribes a party to a consent list or unsubscribes it, for subscribe#ContactListParty, unsubscribe#ContactListParty and apply#UnsubscribePreferences, which check who may. Subscribing sets the party's latest current row to CLPT_ACCEPTED (a new row when it has none) and records a grant for the list unless its last list consent is one, and a grant of the address's marketing purpose when that is withdrawn. Unsubscribing sets every current row to CLPT_UNSUBSCRIBED, or CLPT_UNSUBS_PENDING with a new optInVerifyCode when the list requires confirmation (a current CONT_UNSUB_VER ContactListEmail) and the change is not confirmed (confirmed, or a verifyCode that matches a pending row's), a CLPT_UNSUBSCRIBED row for a party not on the list (a suppression), and records a withdrawal for the list unless its last list consent is one. A change to CLPT_UNSUBS_PENDING sends the verification email (send#UnsubscribeVerifyEmail, in a transaction of its own: one that is not sent is logged and the unsubscribe stays pending). comments (a reason the visitor gave) go on the consent rows. Nothing changes when the party is already in the state asked for.

parameter.name: baseUrl
parameter.description: The site's root for the verification email's link

service.description: Internal, for set#ContactListPartySubscription: the email that asks a party to confirm its unsubscribe from a list that requires it, to the address (contactMechId when it is an email address, else the party's primary one). The template is the emailTemplateId of the list's current CONT_UNSUB_VER ContactListEmail, else, when the list has a verifyEmailFrom, MANTLE_UNSUBSCRIBE_VERIFY (from verifyEmailFrom, the subject verifyEmailSubject or "Confirm your unsubscribe from" the list). Its bodyParameters are verifyUrl (the unsubscribe page with a new token for the party on the list, valid 14 days, and the code: baseUrl/u/token?verifyCode=code), verifyCode, contactListId, contactListName, organizationName, partyId, fromAddress, fromName and subject; a template with no body screen gets a short body with the link. With no template or no address nothing is sent (sent false, logged); a template that cannot send is an error.

Subscribes a party (the current user's by default) to a consent list again, or for the first time: the party's row goes to CLPT_ACCEPTED (from unsubscribed, pending or an unsubscribe waiting for its confirmation) with a consent grant for the list, and the address's marketing consent is granted again when it was withdrawn (allowSolicitation back to Y). The source defaults to PcsStaff for another party, PcsForm for the user's own. Already subscribed changes nothing. A mailbox is joined with ContactListServices.join#ContactList instead.

parameter.name: contactMechId
parameter.description: The address to send to; defaults to the row's preferredContactMechId

service.description:
Unsubscribes a party from one consent list, or with allMarketing from all marketing email: every consent list of email it is on (of the token list's organization, for a token) and a withdrawal of PcpMarketingEmail for the address (the token's or contactMechId, else each current email address of the party, else the party), which sets the address's allowSolicitation to N. Each list goes to CLPT_UNSUBSCRIBED, or CLPT_UNSUBS_PENDING when it requires confirmation (see set#ContactListPartySubscription), with a PartyConsent withdrawal for the list. Calling it again changes nothing.
By token (the unsubscribe page, and the RFC 8058 one-click POST with listUnsubscribe=One-Click): runs for an anonymous visitor; the token is checked first, and only the token's party is changed, on the token's list or another of that organization's lists the party is on (contactListId). The source is PcsEmailLink. A one-click call is confirmed (CLPT_UNSUBSCRIBED at once); otherwise only a verifyCode matching the pending row confirms. Without a token: a signed-in user, with contactListId (unless allMarketing) and partyId; source PcsStaff by default, and confirmed=true skips the confirmation. reasonText (why, as the visitor or staff gave it) goes on the consent rows as their comments; an unsubscribe that waits for confirmation sends the verification email, its link under baseUrl (verifyEmailSent).

parameter.name: listUnsubscribe
parameter.description: One-Click for the RFC 8058 POST, whose form field List-Unsubscribe=One-Click the route passes here; Mailto for the email to the List-Unsubscribe mailto (process#UnsubscribeEmail, which gives the sender as evidenceText)

parameter.name: statusId
parameter.description: The list's status after, for one list

service.description: The List-Unsubscribe mailto of a list email (create#UnsubscribeToken with mailtoAddress): a received email whose subject is "unsubscribe" and a token unsubscribes the token's party from the token's list at once, as the one-click POST does (unsubscribe#ContactListParty with listUnsubscribe Mailto, the sender as evidence). The email ECA rule of MantleConsent.emecas.xml calls it for each such email an email server brings in: polled (poll#EmailServer), or new in the Inbox of a mail account the deployment syncs (sync#EmailAccount runs the email ECAs once on each new Inbox message it stores), so the address only needs to be an email server the deployment polls or a mail account it syncs. A token that is unknown, ended or refused is logged and the email is taken as handled, so the poll does not keep it; unsubscribed tells whether it unsubscribed.

The Consent screen's bulk action: unsubscribes each of partyIdList from a list (unsubscribe#ContactListParty, each in its own transaction). A party that fails is logged, listed in failedPartyIdList, and the rest go on.

A new unsubscribe link token for a party on a contact list, usually one per message sent: the token (given only here; the row keeps its hash), the page's URL (baseUrl + /u/ + token), the one-click URL (the page's URL itself, RFC 8058: the route's post-transition runs the screen's one-click transition for a POST there; the page's URL + /oneClick, the List-Unsubscribe of the messages sent before, takes the POST too) and the List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post header values for the message: List-Unsubscribe is the page's URL, then with mailtoAddress a mailto (RFC 2369) whose subject is "unsubscribe" and the token. A messageId of a ContactListCommStatus fills the list, party, address and communication event. The address defaults to the party's preferredContactMechId on the list, the purpose to PcpSms for a list of phone numbers, else PcpMarketingEmail. baseUrl defaults to the web request's root URL when there is one. thruDate (or validDays) ends it; with neither it does not expire.

parameter.name: messageId
parameter.description: A Message-ID, with its angle brackets

parameter.name: baseUrl
parameter.description: The site's https root, such as https://example.com

parameter.name: mailtoAddress
parameter.description: An address that takes unsubscribe requests by mail, for the List-Unsubscribe mailto; empty leaves it out

service.description: The token check of the public unsubscribe page's token-route (/u/<token>; the framework calls it with token and routeName before anything of the page runs). An unknown or malformed token is not valid, so the route answers its "link expired or not found" page. A known one is valid: routeContext {expired: false, organizationName, contactListName} while it is current, and {expired: true} with nothing else once it has ended (revoked or expired), so the page can say so in its own words. Read only; the page's calls check the token again.

For the public unsubscribe page /u/<token>, an anonymous visitor's: the organization's name, the token's list and the party's status on it, the address masked (j***@example.com, or the last digits of a phone number), whether its marketing email is withdrawn, and the party's other current lists of that organization (consent lists, not archived) with their status for the preferences. Nothing about the party beyond that. Read only, so a mail scanner that fetches the link changes nothing. The token is checked first; an unknown, revoked or expired one gets an error and no data.

The unsubscribe page's Update preferences, an anonymous visitor's: listChoices, a list of {contactListId, subscribed} (or a map of contactListId to subscribed), subscribes or unsubscribes the token's party on each of the lists resolve#UnsubscribeToken offers (others are skipped and listed in failedContactListIds), each in its own transaction, with source PcsEmailLink; with unsubscribeAll, all marketing email instead (unsubscribe#ContactListParty allMarketing). The token is checked first. reasonText goes on the consent rows of the lists unsubscribed (their comments). A list that requires confirmation waits for it (CLPT_UNSUBS_PENDING, the verification email with its link under baseUrl). Subscribing again here is the page's undo.
